marc:datafield.marc:subfield: Cleo : how a small black cat helped heal a family

Helen Brown wasn't a cat person, but her nine-year-old son Sam was. So when Sam heard a woman telling his mum that her cat had kittens, Sam pleaded to go see them. Helen's heart melted as Sam held one of the kittens in his hands with a look of total adoration. Ina trice the deal was done - the kitten would be delivered to them when she was big enough to leave her mother. A week later, the family suffered a terrible tragedy and, totally traumatised, Helen completely forgot all about the kitten until a little black bundle of fur was delivered to her doorstep. Hellen was ready to send the kitten back, but it wasn't long before Cleo's zest for life helped the grieving family laugh again. --- back cover.
